name: Bird Speaker (Racial)
body:
You can speak with birds.

Prerequisite: Tengu, Wis 13

Benefit: You gain speak with animals as a spell-like ability so long as the animal being spoken to is a bird. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 2 + your Wisdom bonus.
